heading: A model built for climate and land.
intro: Every biodigester reduces dependence on firewood and chemical fertilizer, while capturing methane that would otherwise be released into the atmosphere.

goals.title: Affordable clean energy
goals.text: Biogas replaces charcoal for household cooking.

goals.title: Responsible consumption
goals.text: Organic waste becomes a resource instead of a discard.

goals.title: Climate action
goals.text: Methane capture and reduced deforestation tied to firewood use.

goals.title: Zero hunger
goals.text: Healthier soils through the Agri-Shell biofertilizer.

goals.title: Decent work
goals.text: Training and jobs for young people in the green sector.

goals.title: Life on land
goals.text: Reforestation and soil protection built into our programs.
